subject: updateTextInput with activeButton. It doesn't upgrade at all.

messages.author: a466f1661df8668c
messages.subject: updateTextInput with activeButton. It doesn't upgrade at all.
parts:
Hello everyone,
I'm developing a shiny app that if you type a text (one or multiple words), it gives you the most probable word you want to write. The prediction is given after the user click on a submit button

I would like that if the predicted word is correct, the user clicks on an action button and the input text automatically updates adding the predicted word. Then the user can click again on the submit button and have a new prediction. And so on.

Here is the code (still at the prototype level). It correctly performs the prediction every time the use push the submit button, but the action button doesn't produce any change


ui.R
shinyUI(fluidPage(
        headerPanel("Word Prediction"),
        
        fluidRow(
                column(4,
                        h3('Enter any text and this app will predict you the next most probable word'),
                        textInput(inputId="inputed", label = 'Type here you text'),
                        submitButton('Submit')                
                ),
                
                column(8,
                        h3('The next word is:'),
                        verbatimTextOutput('outputed'),
                        actionButton('add', 'Accept the predicted word?')
                )
        )
))


server.R ("prediction" is the function that perform the prediction)
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
        
        output$outputed <- renderText({prediction(inputphrase = input$inputed)})
        
        reactive({
                input$add
                input <- input$inputed
                output <- output$outputed
                updateTextInput(session, "inputed", value = paste(input, output, " "))
        })
})
